english.title: Flight crew member fail to inform aeromedical examiner of injury, illness or pregnancy
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the holder of a medical certificate issued under article 161 of the Air Navigation Order 2016 who

(A)_[suffered a personal injury involving incapacity to undertake your functions as a member of the flight crew,]_
(B)_[suffered a significant illness involving incapacity to undertake your functions as a member of the flight crew throughout a period of 21 days or more,]_
(C)_[had reason to believe that you were pregnant,]_

failed to inform an aeromedical examiner authorised by the CAA of such

(D)_[injury as soon as possible]_
(E)_[illness as soon as the period of 21 days had expired]_
(F)_[pregnancy as soon as possible]_
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 166(2) and 265(6) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.

english.standardstatementoffacts:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant, being the holder of a medical certificate issued under article 161 of the Air Navigation Order 2016 who

(A)_[suffered a personal injury involving incapacity to undertake his functions as a member of the flight crew,]_
(B)_[suffered a personal injury involving incapacity to undertake her functions as a member of the flight crew,]_
(C)_[suffered a significant illness involving incapacity to undertake his functions as a member of the flight crew throughout a period of 21 days or more,]_
(D)_[suffered a significant illness involving incapacity to undertake her functions as a member of the flight crew throughout a period of 21 days or more,]_
(E)_[had reason to believe that she was pregnant,]_

failed to inform an aeromedical examiner authorised by the CAA of such

(F)_[injury as soon as possible.]_
(G)_[illness as soon as the period of 21 days had expired.]_
